newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Dornelles receives coffee industry award.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Dornelles receives coffee industry award.

text.p: Brazil's Industry and Commerce Minister Francisco Dornelles on Tuesday received a merit award from coffee roasters for his role in creating a new coffee council which began operating this year.
The council, presided by Dornelles, was created to decide Brazil's internal and international coffee policies and is made up of representatives from the public and the private sectors.

Deputy Carlos Melles was also honored at the annual awards created by the Brazilian Coffee Industry Association (ABIC), which represents roasters, to reward individuals for outstanding contributions to the coffee industry.
